ios.desc:
Zero is the all-in-one fasting tracker and nutrition app built for real results. Most fasting and weight loss apps stop at simply tracking fasts or calories. Zero connects the full picture — fasting, protein, meals, hydration, and habits — so you actually change your body composition, not just your eating schedule.

Here’s how Zero helps you get there: 

• Track your intermittent fasting — Engage timers, streaks, and insights keep you stay motivated and consistent across your entire fasting journey.

• Log meals the smart way — Skip the tedious manual meal entry routine. With Zero Plus, snap a photo and get instant macros, protein composition, and clarity on how effectively your meals support your goals. Your first meal logs are on us, so you can try it before you subscribe.

• Hit your Protein Score — Zero Plus tracks a personalized daily protein target that adapts to your weight and goals. Better protein = better satiety, better muscle retention, better weight loss. Zero makes it automatic.

• Complete the equation: Fasting + Protein — Most people fast or track meals. Zero brings them together so you lose weight, protect muscle, and avoid the pressure and guilt of traditional calorie trackers.

• Stay hydrated to power your fasts — Water tracking with Zero Plus helps you maintain energy, reduce cravings, and support metabolic function throughout the day.

• Build healthy habits that actually matter — Track movement, sleep, mood, and other daily pillars that reinforce your fasting and fueling routine.

• Challenge yourself — Hit protein targets, maintain fasting streaks, and stay accountable with motivating challenges built around outcomes, not vanity metrics.

• Learn the real science — Understand how fasting, protein, and hydration work together for sustainable weight loss and metabolic health — with insights from leading experts.

• See measurable progress — Watch your streaks grow, your protein consistency rise, and your body composition improve with clean, insightful trend views.

Whether you’re starting out or optimizing an existing routine, Zero gives you the structure, guidance, and clarity most apps miss.

Zero is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult your doctor or qualified healthcare provider before making any changes to your diet, fasting routine, or health regimen.

Zero is free to download, with fasting timers, streaks, weekly trends, expert articles, and challenges included. Zero

Unlock the power of intermittent fasting to improve your health and lose weight without counting calories or dieting. 

Reach your healthy weight goals no matter what diet you follow — from keto or low carb to paleo - and never count calories again. With Zero’s expert guidance and simple intermittent fasting tracker, you’ll unlock the full benefits of intermittent fasting to lose weight and burn fat faster.

FREE ZERO FEATURES

TIMER - Set your intermittent fasting goal, start your timer, and stay on track with reminders and insights to keep you motivated on your weight loss journey without the need to count calories. 

LEARN - Fuel your intermittent fasting with our ever-growing content library.

STATISTICS - Chart your progress and map your weight loss journey. Sync with Google Fit to track health markers like weight and sleep to see how they evolve with your intermittent fasting practice.

JOURNAL - Reflect on how you feel during your intermittent fasting. We'll graph your moods so you can track trends and adjust over time.

CHALLENGES - Opt in to Challenges that align with your health goals, invite friends, unlock Achievements, and stay motivated with guidance from weight loss and fasting experts. 

ZERO PLUS PREMIUM FEATURES
Unlock all of the benefits of intermittent fasting with Zero Plus to lose weight and burn fat faster.

PREMIUM CONTENT - Cut through the noise with an exclusive, ever-growing library of videos, articles, audio segments, and Q&As from intermittent fasting experts.

FASTING ZONES - Know what's happening in your body so you can stay motivated to lose weight and keep it off without dieting or counting calories.

quotes.text:
Here's a counter-example. For folks that do intermittent fasting, there's the need to track when you start and stop your fast. It sounds like a simple stopwatch app would solve this problem.

Yet an app like Zero (which is fantastically designed) is still incredibly useful, and has 54k+ reviews, and an average of 5 stars on the App Store: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/zero-fasting-tracker/id1168348542?mt=8

Apps designed for specific purposes often trump general purpose apps that don't focus. We feel this is a similar space where a specific kind of solution is better than a general purpose one.
